claims.statement: The concept applies across FPT, GHEC and GHES and describes a past-year repository contribution graph. Contribution timestamps use UTC, not the user's local time zone; counts need an explicit time boundary.

For organizations using SAML SSO, the user's profile does not show organization contribution activity without an active SSO session. Outside viewers see anonymized organizational activity; absence is not proof of no contribution.

By default contribution graphs and Achievements show public repository activity; users may include private activity with details anonymized. Display settings do not establish access rights or full private-source assessment coverage.

The popular section selects repositories with the most watchers and becomes Pinned after pinning. The Pinned section displays at most six public repositories or gists, not a complete repository inventory or trust score.
The contributions calendar is a visual activity overview, not an independently verified metric of correctness, productivity or enforcement.

The activity-overview reusable says enabling the section shows contribution types and active repositories only where the viewer has read access; enabling also allows organization filtering of the graph and timeline.

Activity-overview organizations are prioritized by activity, with a mentioned organization in the bio prioritized first if the user is its member. Display ranking does not certify organization authority or complete participation.

The timeline includes authored/co-authored commits, proposed pull requests and opened issues, and highlights milestones such as joining an organization. Missing events may require checking continued organization or repository access.

Linked visibility, pinning, viewing and contribution-count reference pages are not reviewed through this receipt. Screenshot references are illustrative assets, not evidence of actual target behavior.
